name: Law
description: Rule, Statute, The Line Somebody Drew And Everybody Agreed To. Law is not Justice, which is moral, nor Order, which is cosmic — it is the human invention of the binding rule: written, enforced, and true because enough people behave as though it is. Its wielders declare terms and make them hold, and they are found wherever Ephemer has courts, contracts or a city watch.

major.name: Bound over
major.card: Restrained by the terms laid on it

severe.name: Condemned
severe.card: Incapacitated — the sentence is being carried out

control.name: The Statute
control.description: You say what the rule is. Afterwards it is the rule.

tiers.text: Declare one prohibition over the area as you draw. A creature that fails is bound by it until the end of its next turn; the moment it breaks the term, its turn ends.
tiers.card: Declare a prohibition — those who fail are bound, and breaking it ends their turn

conditions.name: Bound
conditions.duration: until the end of its next turn

tiers.text: The statute lasts 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns, and breaking it deals force damage equal to Five Times your Verum Modifier.
tiers.card: 1 min (Cha save each turn) · breaking it costs 5×VM force

tiers.text: The statute binds objects and magic too: a named kind of effect — teleportation, summoning, invisibility, healing — simply does not function inside the area.
tiers.card: Name an effect — teleportation, summoning, invisibility, healing — it doesn't work inside

tiers.text: The Letter. Creatures that failed cannot act against the statute at all: the forbidden action does not occur, the resource it would have cost is spent, and the creature knows precisely which clause stopped it.
tiers.card: THE LETTER — the forbidden action doesn't happen, still costs what it would, and they know why

offensive.name: Enforcement
offensive.description: The rule has consequences. You are the consequence.

tiers.text: The damage becomes force. A creature hit or that fails can't take reactions until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Force · no reactions until their next turn

tiers.text: Against a creature that has broken a law, oath or stated term in your presence, the seal deals 2 additional dice and its damage can't be reduced.
tiers.card: +2 dice against a rule-breaker, and the damage can't be reduced

tiers.text: A creature that fails is Restrained until the end of its next turn — bound over, and aware of the charge.
tiers.card: Restrained until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: Sentence. Name the offence aloud: a creature that fails is Paralysed until the end of its next turn, and for 1 minute afterwards it cannot use the ability, weapon or magic it committed the offence with.
tiers.card: SENTENCE — Paralysed a turn, then barred from the thing it did it with for 1 min

conditions.name: Paralysed
conditions.duration: until the end of its next turn

supportive.name: Standing
supportive.description: They are acting within their rights, and the world can tell.

tiers.text: For 1 hour the target's word carries weight: advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation checks with anyone who recognises an authority, and nobody may lie to it without you knowing.
tiers.card: 1 hr: advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation with the law-abiding · you catch every lie to it

tiers.text: It gains immunity to being Charmed or compelled by anything that would make it break its duty, and adds your Verum Modifier to saves against being moved, bound or silenced.
tiers.card: No charm or compulsion against its duty · +{VM} against being moved, bound or silenced

tiers.text: Once while this lasts the target may declare one action taken against it unlawful: that action fails, and its resource is spent.
tiers.card: Once: declare an action against it unlawful — it fails and is wasted

tiers.text: Above Reproach. Contracts, curses, geasa, bindings and compulsions laid on the target without its consent simply do not take, and anyone who tries is known to you both by name.
tiers.card: ABOVE REPROACH — no unconsented contract, curse or binding takes · you both learn who tried

creation.name: The Instrument
creation.description: You do not build things. You execute documents.

tiers.text: Each creation is made under terms you state: what it is for, who may use it, and what happens if it is misused. Those terms hold.
tiers.card: Each creation carries stated terms of use, and they hold

tiers.text: Your Objects may be writs, warrants, seals or contracts that are recognised as genuine by anyone who would know, because they are.
tiers.card: Writs, warrants and seals that are genuinely genuine

tiers.text: Your Structures have jurisdiction: name one rule that applies inside, and it binds everyone who enters, including you.
tiers.card: Structures carry one rule that binds everyone inside — you included

tiers.text: Raise a Court: a permanent Structure in which any agreement made is binding on all parties, enforced by the Cognition, and no one inside can lie about a matter under judgment.
tiers.card: A COURT — permanent · agreements made inside bind, and nobody may lie under judgment

utility.name: The Code
utility.description: Knowing the rule is most of enforcing it, and all of evading it.

tiers.text: Know the law of wherever you stand: what is forbidden, what it costs, who enforces it, and which rules are dead letters.
tiers.card: Know the local law — what's forbidden, the penalty, and which rules nobody enforces

tiers.text: Draft a binding agreement between willing parties: its terms are enforced by the Cognition, and all parties know exactly what they have agreed to.
tiers.card: Draft an agreement the Cognition itself enforces

tiers.text: Determine whether a creature has broken a law in the last month, which one, and whether anyone knows.
tiers.card: Know what laws someone broke this month, and who knows

tiers.text: Find the loophole: name any rule, contract, curse or binding, and learn the one legitimate way out of it — if there is one, and there usually is.
tiers.card: Find the one legitimate way out of any rule, contract or binding

complementEffects.name: In Contempt
complementEffects.description: The seal cites them for it on the way past.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus force damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6) — two dice if it has broken a stated rule, oath or law in your presence.
effect.card: +1 die force — +2 dice against a rule-breaker

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Two dice, or four, and it can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.
Level 11+: Three dice, or six, and it is Restrained until the end of its next turn.

complementEffects.name: Warranted
complementEffects.description: Whatever the seal's targets do next, they are entitled to do it.

effect.text: Each of the seal's targets adds your Verum Modifier to saving throws against being bound, silenced, moved or compelled until the end of its next turn.
effect.card: The seal's targets: +{VM} against binding, silencing, forced movement and compulsion

upgrades.text: Level 5+: It lasts 1 minute, and they can't be Charmed while it does.
Level 11+: Once each, they may refuse one effect that would bind or compel them outright.
upgrades.card: Once each: refuse a binding outright

complementEffects.name: Injunction
complementEffects.description: The seal attaches a condition they did not agree to.

effect.text: Name one action as the seal lands. A creature hit by or failing it can't take that action until the end of its next turn.
effect.card: Name an action — those hit or failing can't take it until their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: It lasts 1 minute, with a save at the end of each of its turns.
Level 11+: Breaking the injunction deals force damage equal to Five Times your Verum Modifier.
